key.name: last-page
key.description: The sidebar item selected when the window closed: "today", "browse", "stats", or "deck:ID" for one of the decks.

key.name: show-remaining
key.description: Whether the review page's header shows how many new, learning and due cards are left in the session.

key.name: show-intervals
key.summary: Show the next interval on each answer button

key.name: auto-play-audio
key.summary: Play a card's sound when it is shown

key.name: two-button-mode
key.summary: Answer with Again and Good only
key.description: Whether the review page offers only Again and Good, keeping the grading simple; Hard and Easy stay reachable from the keyboard.

key.name: card-text-scale
key.summary: Text size of the card face
key.description: A factor on the card's font size: 1.0 is the card's own size, 1.5 half again as large.

key.name: day-start-hour
key.summary: Hour at which a new day starts
key.description: Cards due today are those due before this hour of the next day, so a late-night session still belongs to the day it started in.

key.name: learn-ahead-minutes
key.summary: Minutes a learning card may be shown early
key.description: When nothing else is due, a card in learning whose step ends within this many minutes is shown rather than making you wait.

key.name: ankiconnect-enabled
key.description: Whether Retain answers AnkiConnect requests on 127.0.0.1:8765, so that Yomitan and similar tools on this computer can add notes. Web pages are always refused.

key.name: ankiconnect-key
key.description: When not empty, an AnkiConnect request must carry this key.
